Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

The Companion Animal Travel Desk handles routine intake, checks, and handoff tasks for traveling pets. Staff must keep records neat, speak plainly, and maintain calm service at every point of contact.

The desk opens each case with a review of travel details, carrier condition, and required paperwork. The passenger coordinator explains the needed steps in direct terms and confirms that the traveler understands the process. The safety coordinator reviews hazards, prevention measures, and any special handling concerns before the animal moves forward. Staff must note anything unusual at once and keep the file current.

Carriers must be treated as secure property and moved carefully between services. The ground team is responsible for steady transport, clean handling, and clear communication during every transfer. No one may rush a transfer or leave a carrier unattended in a public area.

If a traveler presents a concern, staff should remain courteous, document the issue, and route it to the proper lead without delay. Any unresolved condition must stay in review until the right support is in place.

For guidance beyond this section, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
